task:
FIX ONE CONFIRMED REVIEW FINDING on PR #789 by recording and checking a COMPLETE fixture digest. Target branch codex/run-37834232716-1; fail closed unless its head starts with 17536ea. Only scripts/dev/seed_v3_fixture_generation.py and tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py may change.

FINDING (comment 4223902616): the idempotent ownership check compares system fields and (body_pk, system_id64) pairs, but a rebuilt fixture could change any other derived input (body type, landability, rings, signals, raw subType) and the old publication would still be accepted. Field-by-field comparison can never be complete; use a whole-fixture digest instead.

DESIGN (implement exactly):
1. Fixture digest = lowercase hex sha256 of the raw bytes of <fixture_dir>/manifest.json. manifest.json already pins sha256 of canonical.json, source-metadata.json and spansh-system-dumps.zip, and load_source_fixture verifies those files against it, so this one digest covers the whole fixture. Compute it in a small helper _fixture_digest(fixture_dir) and ALWAYS call load_source_fixture(fixture_dir) first in both paths so the files are verified against the manifest before the digest is trusted.
2. First-publish path: the reason passed to v3_meta.publish_derived_generation becomes f'{publication_note} [fixture_manifest_sha256={digest}]'. publication_actor is passed unchanged. Nothing else in the first-publish path changes. Make sure the combined reason still passes the preflight non-blank rule.
3. Idempotent path: keep the existing checks (generation-key prefix, current canonical pointer equals the pinned pointer, bounded systems/bodies content checks) and ADD: read v3_meta.derived_publication_audit WHERE publication_sequence = <current sequence> AND to_generation_id = <current derived_generation_id> (select derived_generation_id in _published_generation for this). Require exactly one row whose actor == publication_actor and whose reason ends with exactly f' [fixture_manifest_sha256={digest}]'. Otherwise raise RuntimeError('fixture digest mismatch') (or 'publication audit missing' when no row) and change nothing.
4. Grep the repo for any test or code that asserts the exact audit reason text 'cypress v3 finder journey' or reads derived_publication_audit.reason; if one exists and the change breaks it, update only if it is in the two allowed files, otherwise STOP and report it without changing it.

TESTS (add only; do not edit or remove existing tests) in tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py, PostgreSQL cases using the existing skip guard and disposable-DB pattern:
 - after a Cypress publish, the audit row's reason equals 'cypress v3 finder journey [fixture_manifest_sha256=' + sha256(manifest.json bytes) + ']' and actor is 'cypress-seed'; a re-seed with the Cypress wrapper returns 1.
 - copy tests/fixtures/cypress_v3_sources to tmp_path, change ONE body-level non-identity field in canonical.json (e.g. a body's distance_from_arrival_ls) keeping all ids, rewrite manifest.json hashes so it loads; re-seeding with the Cypress prefix and that copy raises RuntimeError; still exactly one derived generation at sequence 1.
 - same publish, then re-seed calling seed_v3_fixture_generation with the Cypress fixture and prefix but publication_actor='someone-else' raises RuntimeError.

VALIDATE and report: py_compile; ruff on both files; python -m pytest tests/test_seed_cypress_v3_generation.py tests/test_review_lab_v3.py tests/test_cypress_v3_fixture.py -q -rs. If PostgreSQL is unavailable say the DB cases skipped; the reviewer runs them on PostgreSQL 18. git diff --name-only showing only the two allowed paths.
